title: Installation of Officers and Directors
excerpt: Join Council 14772 for Mass and the installation of officers and directors for Columbian Year 2026–2027, followed by a dinner dance celebration.
description: Knights of Columbus Council 14772 welcomes members, families, and friends to the installation of officers and directors for Columbian Year 2026–2027. The evening begins with Mass and continues with a dinner dance at Madonna Hall, celebrating brotherhood and service.
imageAlt: Flyer for the Council 14772 Installation of Officers and Directors on August 8, 2026
schedule: Dinner dance celebration immediately following Mass
location: St. Genevieve Church, Madonna Hall, 14061 Roscoe Blvd., Panorama City, CA 91402

title: Harrah’s Casino Turnaround Fundraising Event
excerpt: Support Council 14772 at a Harrah’s Casino turnaround fundraiser, with bus transportation departing Panorama City at 8:00 a.m.
description: Knights of Columbus St. Genevieve Council 14772 invites supporters to a Harrah’s Casino turnaround fundraising event. The chartered bus will leave promptly from the Panorama City post office. Participation supports the council’s charitable and community work.
imageAlt: Flyer for the Harrah’s Casino Turnaround Fundraising Event on September 5, 2026
location: In front of the post office, 14416 Chase Street, Panorama City, CA 91402
